speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A neighbour's voice at the casement, scolding a prentice. None of it mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I shut it. The words stopped. The air stopped with them. I want the air back, and I will not have the prentice with it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The four lines are out. Twelve feet is the measure. The back is yesterday's, and I am sitting. Egeon at two.
